environment.next_build: next build --webpack (Turbopack refuses the linked node_modules on this machine)
environment.servers: tools/e2e-runtime-api.mjs started by hand on 127.0.0.1:18800 (E2E_API_PORT) and named by API_INTERNAL_URL, so no other agent's fixture on the shared :8000 could answer; next start on 127.0.0.1:3297, started and stopped by Playwright. The first run, before review, used Playwright's own fixture on :8000 and port 3187.

review_correction: Review found that the first run's synthetic store kept a connection test's browser_status and active_jobs and sent them back on every later read, so its layout screenshots showed the background status and job count after a page load. apps/api/app/video_youtube/vps_settings.py never stores them: view() leaves both null and only test_connection's answer adds them (model_copy(update=details)). The store now does the same, the layout case asserts a page load shows neither, and every file below was regenerated by the rerun; only the layout case's read in the observed requests changed (idle and 0 became null).
commands: API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18800 PLAYWRIGHT_SERVE_BUILD=true PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3297 VPS_ACCEPTANCE_DIR=<this folder> npx playwright test e2e/admin-video-vps-settings.spec.ts --workers=2
the same without VPS_ACCEPTANCE_DIR and with --repeat-each=2

results.machine_load: CPU at 100 percent with other agents running; the first case took up to 29 s of its 60 s budget in the rerun and up to 43 s in the first run
results.earlier_spec_versions: Uncommitted earlier versions of the spec timed out locally at the default 30 s: in the first case of a worker, before the save and the connection test were split and the two cases with two full renders got 60 s; and once in 24 repeats in the read-only case, before it dropped a layout pass the layout case already makes.

negative_checks: Before the card scrolled itself into view, the uploader-link case failed on both projects at the heading's toBeInViewport (viewport ratio 0).

In the first run, with the synthetic store temporarily echoing the secret in its view, the save-and-reload and read-only cases failed on the secret assertions; the store was restored before that receipt run.
With the card's scroll disabled, its new unit test failed (scrollIntoView called 0 times).

In the rerun, with the store temporarily reporting idle and 0 jobs on every read after a successful test, the layout case failed on both projects at its toHaveCount(0) for the background status; the store was then restored to the hash below, the one the receipt and repeat runs had used.
limitations: A local run on a webpack build; the CI run of the same spec on the default build is the authoritative proof.
The settings requests reach a synthetic store that copies the API's rules; the rules are proven by apps/api/tests/test_video_youtube_vps_settings.py.
No production, VPS, Google, real channel, upload or paid-service operation was performed.
